articles.title: Olney: Red Sox have expressed interest in Marlins All-Star Otto Lopez
articles.description:
"Lopez is a contact hitter, which would make him a fit for the sort of player that Craig Breslow has targeted in the past."

The post Olney: Red Sox have expressed interest in Marlins All-Star Otto Lopez  appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Red Sox are interested in Marlins All-Star Otto Lopez for potential trade.
Lopez is known as a contact hitter, appealing to Red Sox's strategy.
Acquiring Lopez could enhance Boston's batting lineup for the upcoming season.

articles.title: New Red Sox Curtis Mead lands on IL with broken wrist after 1 game with Boston
articles.description:
Despite initial X-ray results offering some optimism, Mead is reportedly dealing with a broken wrist.

The post New Red Sox Curtis Mead lands on IL with broken wrist after 1 game with Boston appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Curtis Mead placed on injured list due to a broken wrist after one game with the Red Sox.
Initial X-ray results were optimistic, but further assessment confirmed the injury.
Mead's absence may affect the Red Sox's lineup and performance this season.
